deduplication_formula: Declared slots minus distinct facts represented by those slots; supplemental source-required roots have zero projection multiplicity and do not change slot denominator.
equivalence_policy: Native enums globally by exact actor/source; frame/bootstrap aliases only under frozen shared-context rule. Other roots retain model/view/variant, actor/schema field, and mutation/observation witness scope. No merge by equal spelling/hash alone.
counterexample_guards: Different participant IDs and opposite generation deltas cannot merge; source/target and baseline/post-mutation coordinates remain distinct.
